repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
fired := false
if (fired == true) {
wait until((#G1_Humidity).humiditySensor_humidity < 50)
fired = false
}
wait until((#G1_Humidity).humiditySensor_humidity >= 50)
all(#Dehumidifier).dehumidifier_setDehumidifierMode("drying")
fired = true

diagnosis.summary: The candidate implements a periodic `if` check instead of a blocking rising-edge wait. The IR requires the cycle to wait until the humidity rises to >= 50 before executing the body, then repeat. The candidate checks the condition at the start of every 1-second iteration, missing the exact rising edge instant and failing to block until the condition becomes true.
diagnosis.change_summary: Replaced the periodic `if` guard with the standard rising-edge state machine: a persistent `fired` flag, a wait for the condition to become false (rearm), a wait for the condition to become true (trigger), the action, and setting the flag. This ensures the action fires exactly on the rising edge and respects the 1-second period between completions.
